summary: The bugle case matches every recorded RNG call and the first 38 screens, then C announces that the visible hostile soldier is ready for battle while JavaScript has only a note_unported for music.c:awaken_soldiers. The whole source function wakes every living mercenary except guards regardless of distance, changes its hostility and wait state, and emits sight- or hearing-based feedback; nearby other monsters use the already-ported awaken_scare branch. The bugle improvisation caller needs to invoke it after the sound and before Wisdom exercise.

source.branch: When a hero improvises on a BUGLE, do_improvisation calls awaken_soldiers(&gy.youmonst) after Hero_playnotes. For every living mercenary other than a guard, the function makes an untamed monster hostile, clears sleep and freezing, restores movement, clears STRAT_WAITMASK, and reports readiness if visible or battle-gear sounds if heard. Other living monsters within hero level times 30 squared-distance units call awaken_scare, with scary true below one third of that range.
callers: music.c:do_improvisation BUGLE arm at 649-658 calls awaken_soldiers with the hero; js/music.js:do_improvisation BUGLE arm prints the sound then only notes the unported call.
dependencies: music.c:awaken_scare is already ported in js/music.js and handles the nonmercenary branch; retain its distance, resistance, fear and RNG behavior.
canseemon, Monnam, Deaf-aware Norep, and monster list iteration determine the visible and heard mercenary messages and source state order.

evidence: Saved v10 evaluation challenges/evaluations/20260928083103-v10.json has 38/40 matching screens, 2851/2851 matching RNG calls, and its first screen mismatch at step 38, where the C message extends the top row and JavaScript does not. The C recording SHA-256 is bb0637589dd1526479948597aa5bb78d1f6bda888e5726641d7a1e22ec2a21e9.
Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/music.c:162-199 defines awaken_soldiers, with a no-distance mercenary arm and distance-limited awaken_scare for other monsters. Its BUGLE caller is at music.c:649-658.

js/music.js:219-226 prints the bugle line but calls note_unported(music.c awaken_soldiers) instead of changing the soldier or emitting the C readiness message. The independent recipe summons a hostile soldier, confirms improvisation, and dismisses the separate music pagers.
